## About
Cypress Auto Salvage is a local source for quality recycled auto parts in Oakland. You can search what we have in stock now online, by image or with a multi-part search, or just call the sales department and tell us what you're after.
Customers tell us the clearer you are about what you need, the better we can help. One reviewer wrote that Mike, the owner, cross-referenced model numbers and sent pictures before she came in, and her part was ready for pickup when she arrived.
We hold a 4.2 rating from 146 Google reviews.

## Services
- Recycled auto parts: Quality used parts for your car, with in-stock inventory you can search online before you call or visit.
- Warranty on mechanical and electrical: Mechanical and electrical items come with a 6 month warranty.
- Help finding what you need: If you don't see it in our inventory, give us a call and we'll find it for you.

## FAQ
Q: How soon will you answer a message?
A: If your message needs a response, we will call or email you within 2 business days.

Q: Do you ship or deliver parts?
A: Yes. We ship by FedEx or freight carrier. Local delivery is available to shops only.

Q: Is there a toll-free number?
A: Yes, you can reach us toll-free at 800-573-7278.
